details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:906-977 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Record GH_PAT budget at sweep end" step (lines 906-920) reads the counter log and prints the end line before three later gh-calling steps run: "Re-run cancelled CI failed jobs once" (922-935), "Ensure the final CI run on reviewed PR heads" (943-964) and "Re-dispatch stale security holds" (966-977). Calls from those steps are never counted in calls_in_job, paginated_in_job or calls_by_token, so the `GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND: github_token` override added at line 926 has no effect.
  WHY: The sweep runs every 30 minutes and makes uncounted calls each time: up to FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK (default 10) PR heads, base syncs, and paginated rerun queries. This undercounts review_autofix_sweep / sweep in the "Top consumers by calls_in_job" ranking, which is what issue #9887 delivers. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: move the end step block, unchanged, to after "Re-dispatch stale security holds".
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2856-2894 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Record GH_PAT budget at clarify end" step (2856-2870, if: always()) prints the end line before the "Report refused AI engine fallbacks" step (2875-2894, GH_TOKEN: secrets.GH_PAT at 2879). That step's PAT calls (ai_engine_fallback_report.sh / workflow-failure-heal dispatch) are never counted.
  WHY: The clarify job's calls_in_job undercounts PAT usage on runs where an AI-engine fallback was refused. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2388-2430 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gh_pat_budget end step (minimax: 2401-2410; glm: 2388-2406) prints the end line before the "Report refused AI engine fallbacks" step (2411-2430), whose PAT calls are never counted.
  WHY: The orchestrate_poll / poll job's calls_in_job undercounts PAT usage. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT; the highest is used.
- agents.d/9887-gh-call-counter.md:12 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Known gaps" text lists the sweep's CI re-run among the instrumented steps that set `GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND: github_token`. That step (review_autofix_sweep.yml:922) runs after the budget end step (review_autofix_sweep.yml:906), so its calls are not captured.
  WHY: The doc claims a capability the workflow does not deliver, so operators will trust a review_autofix_sweep / sweep ranking that is systematically low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash noted the same doc inaccuracy inside their sweep finding.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2775 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "Install gh call counter" step (line 718) is guarded by `steps.refctx.outputs.label_missing_hold != 'true'`, so the shim is never installed on the label_missing_hold path. That path still makes gh calls at lines 272, 291, 329 and 337.
  WHY: Those calls are never counted, and the end line reports `calls_in_job=unknown`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said it did not raise this item because agents.d "Known gaps" already documents calls made before the install step.
- scripts/gh_call_counter/gh:43 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The shim classifies the token kind (pat / github_token / other) by checking whether GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN exists. When both are set, the result may not match the token gh actually uses.
  WHY: calls_by_token counts could be misleading if the shim's precedence differs from gh's. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: the shim gives GH_TOKEN precedence, which matches gh, and the explicit override covers the steps that pass github.token.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every job that already prints `GH_PAT_BUDGET`, plus the release-gate jobs, also prints how many `gh` invocations it made itself, so the top consumers per hour can be ranked from one day of logs." (Issue #9887, Goals)
  expected_change_site: the budget end steps in .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, .github/workflows/clarify.yml and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (each must run after all gh-using steps)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: In review_autofix_sweep.yml the budget end step at lines 906-920 comes before gh-calling steps at lines 922, 943 and 966. In clarify.yml the end step at line 2856 comes before "Report refused AI engine fallbacks" at line 2875. In orchestrate_poll.yml the end step likewise comes before its "Report refused AI engine fallbacks" step. The `GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND: github_token` override added at lines 924-926 has no effect, and these calls are missing from the per-job totals.
- requirement: "Every job that already prints `GH_PAT_BUDGET`, plus the release-gate jobs, also prints how many `gh` invocations it made itself" (issue #9887 Goals)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml, jobs.clarify ("Install gh call counter" step must cover the label-missing-hold path)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The "Install gh call counter" step (lines 718-731) is guarded by `if: steps.refctx.outputs.label_missing_hold != 'true'` (line 721). The label-missing route still makes GH_PAT calls in the refctx step at lines 272, 291, 329 and 337-338 (identity probe, paginated comments fetch, hold comment post, `ai:blocked` label post with retry). The budget end step at line 2856 then runs with if: always() and prints `calls_in_job=unknown`. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes this is partly covered by the agents.d "Known gaps" note.
- requirement: For each invocation, record "which token variable was in effect (`pat` / `github_token` / `other`...)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_call_counter/gh and its interaction with the signed-comment shim in scripts/gh_helpers.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The counter classifies the environment before it execs the signing shim, and post_signed then replaces GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN with AI_COMMENT_JOB_TOKEN at scripts/gh_helpers.sh lines 752-756. Signed requests are therefore recorded as pat although they use the job token; the agents.d fragment documents this misclassification.
- requirement: "Update `collect_workflow_logs.py` and its tests" (implementation steps of linked issue #9887)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: test_pat_budget_line_parses_call_counter_keys was added, but the existing contract tests (test_pat_budget_workflow_listing_marks_api_ceiling_incomplete and others) were not updated to check the new keys in end-to-end report generation for the new jobs. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this gap.
- requirement: Add the docs and fragments (changelog/agents).
  expected_change_site: README.md
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The README.md table of instrumented jobs must stay exactly in sync with the 22 instrumented jobs whenever jobs are added to or removed from test-and-mark-stable.yml. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this: README lines 625-628, the changelog and agents.d all name the eight release-gate jobs and 22 total.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: The sweep runs every 30 minutes and makes uncounted PAT calls each time (up to FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK, default 10, PR heads, plus base syncs and paginated rerun queries). review_autofix_sweep / sweep is therefore undercounted in the "Top consumers by calls_in_job" ranking, which is issue #9887's deliverable.   - luna clarify label_missing_hold path: already documented in agents.d "Known gaps".
